comment: Read from the maker's source at commit fd172d0, the only commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.0 and the tip of the repository. The four columns are one templated block of code, so every column's line is the same line and the tags point all four at it. The HIGH and LOW inputs and the four outputs are left without a family: the module attenuverts and offsets whatever is patched in and the maker's own README uses it both as a CV shaper and as an audio mixer, so no one colour is true of them. There is no configInput or configOutput call anywhere in the file, which is why Rack shows every jack unnamed.
